name: BarleyFinance
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to flash, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a multi-step DeFi attack involving a flash loan, token purchase, liquidity addition, mass deployment of helper contracts, repeated airdrop claims, then liquidity removal and token dump. It requires understanding protocol-specific reward logic and LP-based eligibility abuse, but the execution flow is still fairly direct and not deeply complex.
